domain.name: Distributed Systems
domain.description: High-availability replication, event loops, quorum consensus, and horizontal database sharding.

allDomains.synopsis: In distributed systems, networks are asynchronous, packet loss is normal, and clocks drift. This volume establishes the mental models from node replication and quorum to fault isolation.

domain.name: Software Architecture
domain.description: Decoupled event streaming, microservice resilience, CQRS, and domain-driven design.

allDomains.synopsis: System architecture comprises the decisions that are expensive to reverse. This volume explores decoupled message streaming, bounded contexts, and circuit breakers.

domain.name: Design Patterns
domain.description: GoF structural/behavioral patterns, circuit breakers, sagas, and transactional outbox patterns.

allDomains.synopsis: Proven design idioms that solve recurring structural, behavioral, and architectural challenges with loose coupling and robust resilience.

domain.name: Software Engineering
domain.description: Clean code craft, automated testing pyramids, CI/CD pipelines, refactoring, and technical debt.

allDomains.synopsis: The craftsmanship of sustainable software systems: automated test pyramids, CI/CD verification pipelines, refactoring, and code review rigor.

domain.name: Algorithms & Data Structures
domain.description: B-Trees vs LSM-Trees, graph traversal, consistent hashing rings, and asymptotic time-space trade-offs.

allDomains.synopsis: Hardware geometry dictates algorithmic performance. This volume examines memory hierarchy, B-Trees vs LSM-Trees, cache-oblivious designs, and consistent hashing rings.

domain.name: DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure
domain.description: Layer 4/7 load balancing, container orchestration, distributed tracing, and high-availability SRE.

allDomains.synopsis: Reliability is the non-negotiable feature of software systems. This volume examines layer 4/7 traffic routing, backpressure cascades, and zero-downtime rolling deploys.

domain.name: Security & Distributed Concurrency
domain.description: Distributed locks, Redlock algorithm, fencing tokens, zero-trust auth, and atomic race safety.

allDomains.synopsis: Concurrency bugs are non-deterministic and catastrophic. This volume deconstructs distributed locking, Redlock consensus, fencing tokens, and atomic race condition safety.

domain.name: AI & Machine Learning Systems
domain.description: Vector databases, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embedding indices, and low-latency inference.

allDomains.synopsis: High-throughput vector search, low-latency embedding retrieval, and resilient model inference pipelines under dynamic token generation workloads.
